videoDetails.title: Who Can Be a NASA Astronaut? Myth or Fact
videoDetails.shortDescription:
Who can be a NASA astronaut? The answer may be different than you think.

Applications for astronaut candidates are open until Dec. 3, and we want you to apply! Our current class of astronaut candidates is here to bust some common eligibility myths.

Could you be one of our next astronauts? Apply here: https://go.nasa.gov/astro2026

Download this video: https://go.nasa.gov/4fzJBPg
